pairs.evidence: apps/desktop/client/src/lib/data/useWindowedRows.ts:78 The range extractor pins the remembered focused row without a blur/release path, so moving focus outside the list leaves that off-screen row mounted after its focus claim should end.

techniques.evidence: apps/desktop/client/src/lib/mount.tsx:22 React owns host reconciliation and the browser owns DOM layout; no second product-owned blueprint is required.
